# T2 -- reject an empty config path

`parseConfig(rawPath)` in `src/config.js` hands an empty path straight to
`fs.readFileSync`, so the caller sees a generic `ENOENT` error instead of a
clear validation failure.

## Acceptance criteria

1. `parseConfig('')` (and any non-string path) throws a `TypeError` whose
   message says the path must be a non-empty string, *before* the function
   touches the filesystem.
2. A new test file, `src/config.empty-path.test.js`, asserts this and passes
   under `node --test`.
3. The existing suite in `src/config.test.js` still passes, unmodified.
